summary: Explain why a working neural interface depends on living tissue beyond the neuron it records.
outcomes: Connect support-cell and metabolic roles to signaling reliability.
Explain why tissue responses can change an implanted sensor's measurements.
sequence: Contrast a circuit board with living tissue
Introduce astrocytes, oligodendrocytes, Schwann cells and microglia
Introduce barriers, immune response and interface longevity

visual.question: Why can the same electrode record differently over time?
visual.interaction: Toggle myelin, tissue movement and inflammatory response in explicitly qualitative scenarios.

practice.task: Label a sensor-tissue cross-section and explain two changing-signal scenarios.
practice.success: Separates biological mechanisms from electronics faults and proposes observations to distinguish them.
